VI Helpeks API

Owning Palette: none.

VI Helpeks API VIs are intended to build help projects programmatically and assist developers in creating help system for their VIs.

 

Palette Object Description
Assign Help Info to VIs.vi The VI saves the help information to the specified source VIs and palettes (.mnu files). Files other than VIs or palettes are ignored.
Build Help Info for Help Items.vi The VI prepares information for linking VIs and palettes to help files. An input for this VI can be read from the Help Info File created by VI Helpeks during help generation.
Build VIHelpeks Project.vi The VI builds help files on the basis of the VIHelpeks Project File. A Project file must be preliminary created and configured with VI Helpeks GUI. Information on the built project can be found in the files returned in the Paths indicator.
Create Palettes for VIs in Folder.vi The VI creates palette files for VIs in a folder. It creates a palette for every sub-folder and LLB beneath the given folder recursively.
Create Synchronized Palette.vi The VI creates a palette file synchronized with the given folder. In addition, if allowed, the VI creates a synchronized palette in every sub-folder beneath the given folder recursively.
Read Help Info File.vi The VI reads the Help Info File generated by VI Helpeks during help generation. Help Info File contains information about the generated HTML Help Workshop project files,  the source VI files and their respective HTML files, and information for linking inside CHM file.
Set VI Help from Help Info File (Simple).vi The VI reads the Help Info File generated by VI Helpeks during help generation and, if allowed, saves the help information to the source VIs and palettes (.mnu files) referred in the file. Source files of other types are ignored.
